title: Track (create)
description: A line of research within a project. The server assigns id, state, actor, via, timestamps and revision.

description.description: Markdown: the approach this track explores.

producer.description: Producer step manifest revision; omitted, the project default applies.

mode.description: Who runs the track's experiments: `agent` (outside agents claim them, the default) or `workflow` (a Cannery Row runner claims them and runs `workflow`).

workflow.description: The experiment workflow a `workflow` track runs: registered experiment step manifest revisions, run in order. The last step outputs the run document as `run` (`cr-run/v0.2`): one `run.md` file.
